title: Extend relay-behind-history behavioral coverage for pause, capacity and runnable-user FIFO
outcome: Behavioral tests cover direct-user relay bypass with retained history across the currently unpinned pause, capacity and runnable-user successor combinations.
acceptance: Add a controlled history-plus-refused-relay test with Stop/pause latched, and a history/refused-relay/runnable-user successor test verifying user FIFO and unchanged retained rows.

Cover a busy or capacity-retrying case and a valid relay behind history with observable dispatch/queue/authority assertions; share repeated historical-row fixture construction where useful without source-text or tautological tests.
